items.title: Ohio governor’s race roiled by new viral video featuring Amy Acton’s estranged mother
items.brief: The Ohio governor’s race is being roiled by a new video in which the estranged mother of the Democratic nominee, Amy Acton, urges people not to vote for her.

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla have formed committees to discuss potential merger, Musk says
items.brief: Elon Musk, the CEO of both SpaceX and Tesla, voiced support for merging the two companies during an earnings call Tuesday, though he said it is ultimately up to special shareholder committees from each company.

items.title: Drone strike on a market in disputed African region of Abyei kills at least 153
items.brief: A drone strike on a market in Abyei, a border region disputed by Sudan and South Sudan, hit a nearby fuel depot, killing at least 153 people and igniting a fire that was still burning Tuesday, a local official said.
